origin_lock.core_question: Which aspects of human planning behavior transport across changing reconstruction populations: a state-local geometric law, a historical regime interaction, or neither?
origin_lock.explanandum: R1-adjusted low-overlap next-action residual after repeated failure of method and reconstructor metadata to own a stable sign.
not_licensed: causal effect of era, method, or reconstructor
population-general law beyond the sampled reconstruction archive

parent.authority_note: P14 era interaction was secondary and may generate P15 predictions but did not rescue P14.

sampling_design.exclude: all prior body-contacted source IDs through P14, including replay-repair replacements; expected exclusion count 267 unique IDs and must be verified before selection
sampling_design.cells: 2 method families × 2 reconstructor-frequency bands × 4 eras = 16 cells
sampling_design.within_cell_selection: deterministic SHA-256 rank after exact prior-contact exclusion
sampling_design.batch_assignment: 12 bounded batches ×8 solves; rotate 16-cell assignments so batch is not pure in method, band, or era
sampling_design.replacement_policy: replay-invalid replacement only by separately sealed pre-geometry amendment preserving exact method×band×era cell and batch

frozen_measurement.structural_adjustment: R1 hard caliper on exact 2x2 action-opportunity TV distance <=1 action-mass unit

H_REGIME_STEP.statement: The dominant-minus-nondominant residual gap changes historical regime: positive in early eras E1/E2 and negative in late eras E3/E4.
primary_predictions: at least 3 of 4 era gap signs match the presealed early-positive/late-negative pattern

H_STATE_LOCAL.statement: After R1 state-local adjustment, residual structure is stable across eras and apparent metadata sign exchange is mixture noise.
primary_predictions: leave-one-era-out pooled residual signs are invariant
method and reconstructor-band marginal gaps remain below 1/18 in absolute value

H_NONSTATIONARY_MIXTURE.statement: Neither a stable historical step nor a stable state-local residual law transports; observed sign ownership is archive/population mixture-sensitive.
H_NONSTATIONARY_MIXTURE.role: fallback scientific conclusion if both structured rivals fail; not tuned as an alternative predictive model

adjudication.REGIME_CONFIRMED: all H_REGIME_STEP primary predictions pass and H_STATE_LOCAL early-late invariance fails
adjudication.STATE_LOCAL_TRANSPORT: all H_STATE_LOCAL primary predictions pass and H_REGIME_STEP does not fully pass
adjudication.MIXED_OR_PARTIAL: at least one structured rival has some but not all primary predictions pass
adjudication.NONSTATIONARY_MIXTURE_SUPPORTED: neither structured rival passes any complete primary package while frozen support floors are met
adjudication.SUPPORT_LIMITED: any terminal package is non-evaluable because support floors fail

ravel.strongest_attack: Repeated sign reversal of named metadata coordinates means P15 must discriminate transport structure itself rather than nominate another metadata owner.
ravel.return_edge: use naturalistic reconstruction data to decide whether any state-local planning law survives historical archive shifts before reopening human mechanism contact

forbidden: promote P14 secondary era interaction before P15 fresh outcome
change R1, Q5, era definitions, thresholds, or support floors after body contact
use prior corpora in fresh96 terminal verdict
